```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)
```

MicroFun takes a PICRUSt2 contribution table and a phyloseq object containing
sample metadata and ASV taxonomy. Match ASV and sample identifiers before analysis.
The examples below use user-supplied files and a metadata column named `Group`.

```{r}
library(MicroFun)
ps <- readRDS("phyloseq.rds")
contributions <- "picrust2_out/KO_metagenome_out/pred_metagenome_contrib.tsv.gz"

result_taxa <- pathway_sdaa(
  contributions, ps, group = "Group", taxon_level = "Genus",
  direction = "taxa", pathway = "KO", reference = "Control"
)
result_function <- pathway_sdaa(
  contributions, ps, group = "Group", taxon_level = "Genus",
  direction = "function", pathway = "KO", reference = "Control"
)
```

Each direction has its own statistical analysis. Do not transpose a taxon-centred
result and treat it as function-centred inference.

```{r}
p <- tax2fun_sankey(
  result_taxa, tree_mode = "phylogeny", physeq = ps,
  picrust2_dir = "picrust2_out", taxon_level = "Genus"
)
q <- fun2tax_sankey(
  result_function, tree_mode = "taxonomy", physeq = ps,
  taxon_level = "Genus"
)
save_sankey(p, "taxa_to_function.html")
save_sankey(p, "taxa_to_function.pdf")
save_sankey(q, "function_to_taxa.html")
```

Use unagglomerated ASV taxonomy to match tree tips. Independent trees form a
forest. A non-monophyletic genus can occupy multiple branches; only pure taxon
clades collapse together. Mapping connectors do not multiply association weights.

```{r}
c <- tax2fun_chord(
  result_taxa, contributions, ps, group = "Group", taxon_level = "Genus",
  contrast = c("Control", "Treatment"), draw = FALSE
)
save_chord(c, "chord.html")
save_chord(c, "chord.pdf", width = 18, height = 16)
saveRDS(c, "chord.rds")
```

Chord widths represent contributions, while bar heights represent absolute model
effects. In particular, Maaslin2 AST coefficients are not log fold changes.
Inspect `c$links`, `c$settings` and `c$diagnostics` to review the plotted data.
